entries.jp: シンディの隠れ家に\n着いたはいいけど\n興奮して眠れないぜよ
entries.en:
We made it to
Shindy's hideout,
but I'm too fired
up to sleep!

entries.jp: スカシくんイチオシの\n隠れ家が素敵すぎて\nヘドが出そうとか？
entries.en:
Is Mr. Poser's
top-pick hideout
so lovely it makes
you wanna puke?

entries.jp: どうせ一時しのぎの\n場所だが　嫌なら\n出ていってもいいぜ
entries.en:
It's only a stopgap
anyway. If you
don't like it, feel
free to leave.

entries.jp: 総司　ここは我慢しろ\n夜露をしのげるだけでも\nありがたいからな
entries.en:
Soji, bear with it.
Just having a roof
over our heads is
something to be
grateful for.

entries.jp: 一人二人ならともかく\n男五人で遊郭に隠れるとは\n考えにくいからな
entries.en:
One or two men,
maybe, but no
one would expect
five men to hide
out in a pleasure
quarter.

entries.jp: それにしても豪華絢爛って\n感じですね　この部屋
entries.en:
Still, this room is
quite the picture
of luxury and
splendor.

entries.jp: こんなところに通うなんて\nスカシくん欲求に素直すぎ
entries.en:
Coming to a
place like this?
Mr. Poser's way
too honest
about his urges.

entries.jp: ば　バカ野郎！\n通っちゃいねえって！\n健全なんだよオレ様は
entries.en:
Y-you idiot! I
don't come
here! The
great Takasugi
is perfectly
wholesome!

entries.jp: ふうん　健全ね
entries.en: Huh.\nWholesome, huh.

entries.jp: 前にお登勢さんから\nここは見つかりにくいって\n聞いてたんだよ
entries.en:
Otose-san told
me a while back
that this place
is hard to find.

entries.jp: 何かあった時は\nここへ逃げ込めってな
entries.en: Said if anything\never happened, I\nshould run here.

entries.jp: うは　ウソ臭い\nどうせなら笑えるウソに\nしたほうがいいね
entries.en:
Pfft, sounds fake.
If you're gonna
lie, at least make
it a funny one.

entries.jp: 信じろよ\n女将はオレ達を見るなり\nすぐ通してくれただろうが
entries.en:
Believe me! The
landlady let us
right in the
moment she saw
us, didn't she!

entries.jp: しかしまあ部屋の中が\n煌びやかなのはたしかだな
entries.en: That said, the\nroom certainly\nis dazzling.

entries.jp: ああ　目がキラキラ\nチカチカして眠れん
entries.en:
Yeah,
everything's
so sparkly and
flashy, I can't
sleep a wink.

entries.jp: じゃあ眠くなるまで\nお話でもしようか\nおとぎ話的なやつ
entries.en:
Then let's tell
stories till we
get sleepy. Like
a fairy tale.

entries.jp: ほう　総司がおとぎ話か\nピンと来ないな
entries.en: Oh? Soji, telling\nfairy tales? I\ncan't picture it.

entries.jp: ひどいな　僕だって\nおとぎ話ぐらい知ってるよ
entries.en: How mean. Even\nI know a fairy\ntale or two.

entries.jp: おお　おとぎ話か\nそりゃあええ\n聞かせてくれ　ソウちん
entries.en:
Ooh, a fairy
tale! Sounds
great! Let's
hear it, So-chin.

entries.jp: 京の都に伝わる\nおとぎ話を聞きたいぜよ
entries.en:
I wanna hear a
fairy tale
handed down in
Kyoto, I tell ya!

entries.jp: 京の話かぁ\nちょうど良いのがあるよ\nすごく面白いんだ
entries.en:
A Kyoto story,
huh? I've got just
the one. It's super
interesting.

entries.jp: 都の千本通りと出水通りの\n四辻って言うとわかる？
entries.en:
You know the
crossroads
where Senbon
Street meets
Demizu Street?

entries.jp: ああ　知っている\nそこがどうした？
entries.en: Yes, I know it.\nWhat about it?

entries.jp: あの辺りって\n宴（えん）の松原って\nいうらしいの　知ってる？
entries.en:
Did you know that
area's apparently
called the En no
Matsubara, the
Banquet Pines?

entries.jp: 聞いたことはあるな\n平安の頃は内裏の一部の\n松林だったって話だ
entries.en:
I've heard of it.
Back in the Heian
days, it was a
pine grove inside
the imperial
palace grounds,
or so they say.

entries.jp: ほうほう\nその宴の松原が\nどうしたんじゃ？
entries.en:
Uh-huh,
uh-huh. So what
about this En no
Matsubara?

entries.jp: ははっ　龍馬くん\n興味津々ですね
entries.en: Ha ha,\nRyoma-kun,\nyou're all ears.

entries.jp: そりゃ気になるって\n都の話は刺激が一杯だし
entries.en:
Well, sure I'm
curious! Stories
from the capital
are full of thrills!

entries.jp:
その松林にね
夜な夜なすごい
色男（イケメン）が
現れたんだって
entries.en:
In that pine
grove, night
after night, a
gorgeous hunk
would appear.

entries.jp: 着物の着こなしが粋で\n夜目でもスッと通った\n顔立ちが目立つほどにね
entries.en:
He wore his
kimono with
style, and his
fine features
stood out even
in the dark.

entries.jp: おお　ソウちんの語りを\n聞いてるだけで　色男が\n目に浮かんできた！
entries.en:
Ooh, just hearin'
you tell it,
So-chin, I can
picture that hunk!

entries.jp: そこへ内裏の女房衆三人が\nちいさな灯りを手にして\n通りがかったんだ
entries.en:
Then three court
ladies from the
palace came by,
carrying little
lanterns.

entries.jp: おおっ\nそこで色男とバッタリ\n鉢合わせしたか！
entries.en: Ooh! And they\nbumped right\ninto the hunk!

entries.jp: 何かと思ったら\n逢い引きの話かよ\nつまらねぇ
entries.en:
And here I
wondered what
it'd be. A tryst
story? Boring.

entries.jp: ふふふ……\nここからがこの話の\n面白いところなんだよ
entries.en: Hehehe... This is\nwhere the story\ngets interesting.

entries.jp: 続き！　続きは
entries.en: Go on! What\nhappens next!?

entries.jp: 三人の女房が\n男に見とれていると\nその男が寄ってきたんだ
entries.en:
As the three
ladies gazed at
the man, he came
toward them.

entries.jp: 足音もなく風のように\nすうっと寄ってきた
entries.en: Without a sound,\nlike the wind, he\nglided closer.

entries.jp: おかしいと思わない？\n普通じゃないよね\n音もなく歩くなんてさ
entries.en:
Don't you think
that's weird?
It's not normal,
walking without
a sound.

entries.jp: わかった！\nその色男は忍の者！
entries.en: I got it! That\nhunk's a ninja!

entries.jp: 黙って聞いてろ　龍馬\n話がややこしくなる
entries.en:
Shut up and
listen, Ryoma.
You're making
it confusing.

entries.jp: でも　女房は男に見とれて\nおかしいと思わなかった
entries.en:
But the ladies
were so taken
with him they
didn't think it
was weird.

entries.jp: その色男に取り憑かれた\nみたいにぼんやりとして\n見とれていたんだよね
entries.en:
They just
stared at him in
a daze, like he'd
bewitched them.

entries.jp: おいおい\nぜんぜんおとぎ話じゃねえ\n雰囲気だな……
entries.en: Hey, hey... This\nisn't sounding like\na fairy tale at all...

entries.jp: そのうちその男は\n女房のうち一番美しい女に\n手を差し出した
entries.en:
Eventually, the
man held out
his hand to the
most beautiful
of the ladies.

entries.jp: 二人の女房を残して\n男と女房は手を繋いで\n松林の奥へと消えたわけ
entries.en:
Leaving the
other two behind,
he and the lady
walked hand in
hand and
vanished deep
into the pines.

entries.jp: そ　それで　その女房は\nどうなったんじゃ？
entries.en: Wh-what\nhappened to\nthat lady?

entries.jp: しばらくは色男と\n女房の楽しげな会話が\n続いたそうなんだ
entries.en:
For a while, they
say, you could
hear the hunk
and the lady
chatting happily.

entries.jp: 残された二人の女房が\n帰宅時間だからって\n松林に捜しに行くと……
entries.en:
Then, since it
was time to head
home, the two
left behind went
into the pines to
look for her...

entries.jp: おおっ\nワクワクしてきた！
entries.en: Ooh! This is\ngettin' excitin'!

entries.jp: 辺りを捜しても誰もいない\n女房が着ていた着物だけが\n松の枝にぶら下がっててね
entries.en:
They searched
all around, but
no one was
there. Only the
lady's kimono,
hanging from
a pine branch.

entries.jp: ……天女になったとか？
entries.en: ...She turned\ninto a celestial\nmaiden?

entries.jp: ふふ　近いかもね
entries.en: Hehe, maybe\nthat's close.

entries.jp: あたり一面は血の海で\n女房の手と足だけが\n転がってたんだって
entries.en:
The ground all
around was a
sea of blood,
with only the
lady's hands and
feet lying there.

entries.jp: その色男は\n実は妖鬼で女房を食った\nなんて言い伝えられてる
entries.en:
Legend says
the hunk was
really a demon
who ate her.

entries.jp: それ天女と違うっ\nお星さまになったんじゃ！
entries.en:
That ain't no
celestial maiden!
She went up to
join the stars!

entries.jp: な　なんて恐ろしい話じゃ\nなんまんだぶなんまんだぶ
entries.en:
Wh-what a
terrifyin' story!
Namu Amida
Butsu, Namu
Amida Butsu...

entries.jp: バカ野郎　沖田　てめぇ\nそれは怪談じゃねえか！\n龍馬がビビってんだろ
entries.en:
You idiot, Okita!
That's a ghost
story! You're
scaring Ryoma!

entries.jp: どうしてスカシくんが\nキレてるんだよ\nビビッちゃったわけ？
entries.en:
Why are you the
one losing it,
Mr. Poser? Did
you get scared?

entries.jp: なっ　オレ様がビビるわけ\nねえだろ……\nバカにすんなよ　沖田
entries.en:
Wh-! Like the
great Takasugi
would get
scared... Don't
mock me, Okita.

entries.jp: 晋作　声震えてます　声
entries.en: Shinsaku, your\nvoice is shaking.\nYour voice.

entries.jp: 本当に怖いのは\nこのおとぎ話自体じゃ\nないんだよね
entries.en:
The truly
scary part isn't
this fairy tale
itself, though.

entries.jp: いかん　厠へ行けなく\nなりそうじゃ
entries.en: Uh-oh, I won't\nbe able to go\nto the privy...

entries.jp: おかしいと思わない？\n斬ったって頭や胴体が\n消えるわけないよね？
entries.en:
Don't you think
it's weird? Even if
you cut someone
up, their head
and body don't
just vanish, right?

entries.jp: お　おう\n爆死したならともかくな
entries.en: Y-yeah. Unless\nthey got\nblown to bits.

entries.jp: そうだよね\n色男の妖鬼ってのは\n二人の女房のウソなんだ
entries.en:
Right? The
demon hunk was
a lie the two
ladies made up.

entries.jp: どういうことなんだ？
entries.en: What do\nyou mean?

entries.jp: 本当は女房二人が共謀し\n美人の女房をぶち殺して\n妖鬼のせいにした……
entries.en:
In truth, the two
ladies conspired,
murdered the
beautiful one,
and blamed it on
a demon...

entries.jp: なんのために殺害を？
entries.en: Killed her\nfor what?

entries.jp: さあね　女房同士で\nなにがあったかなんて\n僕にはわからないけどね
entries.en:
Who knows. What
went on between
the ladies, I
couldn't tell you.

entries.jp: 内裏のことだからね\n大奥も似たようなものだし
entries.en:
It's the imperial
court, after all.
The shogun's
inner palace isn't
much different.

entries.jp: ありそうな話です……\n説得力が増してきたら\n背筋が寒くなってきました
entries.en:
It does sound
plausible... The
more convincing
it gets, the colder
my spine feels.

entries.jp: 女房二人が疑われないよう\n妖鬼が女房を食ったように\n見せかける必要があるよね
entries.en:
So nobody
would suspect
them, they had
to make it look
like the demon
ate her, right?

entries.jp: お　おう\nそそそ　そうだな
entries.en: Y-yeah. R-r-right.

entries.jp: 埋めたか　動物かなにかに\n食わせたんじゃないかな\nその証拠に……
entries.en:
Maybe they
buried the rest,
or fed it to
some animal.
And the proof...

entries.jp: 今では色男妖鬼じゃなく\n殺された女房の幽霊が出る\nらしいからね
entries.en:
...is that these
days, instead of
the demon hunk,
it's the murdered
lady's ghost that
appears.

entries.jp: こわーっ！
entries.en: Yikes!

entries.jp: なんとも救われない\n話ですね　沖田くん……
entries.en: What a hopeless\nstory, Okita-kun...

entries.jp: はっ　そんな話のどこが\n怖いんだよ　馬鹿馬鹿しい
entries.en:
Hah! What's so
scary about a
story like that?
Ridiculous.

entries.jp: そういえば宴の松原って\nこのすぐ近くですよね
entries.en:
Come to think
of it, the En
no Matsubara
is right near
here, isn't it?

entries.jp: あ\nそ　そうだった……
entries.en: Ah... Th-that's\nright...

entries.jp: あれ　晋作って\nこの手の話はまるっきり\n苦手だったはずですが？
entries.en:
Hm? Shinsaku,
weren't you
completely
hopeless with
this sort of story?

entries.jp: ななな　なに言ってんだっ\nオレ様に怖いものなんぞ\nねえよ
entries.en:
Wh-wh-what
are you talking
about!? There's
nothing the
great Takasugi
is afraid of!

entries.jp: わしは怖いぜよ\n幽霊は苦手なんじゃあ！
entries.en: Well, I'm\nscared! I can't\nstand ghosts!

entries.jp: あ　言い忘れてた\nその女房の幽霊って\n着物と手と足だけでね
entries.en:
Oh, I forgot to
mention. That
lady's ghost is
just a kimono,
hands and feet...

entries.jp: 胴体と頭を捜して\n夜な夜な京の都を\n歩いてるらしいよ
entries.en:
...and they say
she walks the
streets of Kyoto
night after night,
looking for her
body and head.

entries.jp: うおおおお\nチビりそうになってきた\nもうやめるぜよ～
entries.en: Uwaaah, I'm about\nto wet myself!\nStop it already~

entries.jp: ジタバタするんじゃねえ\nみっともねえ野郎だな
entries.en: Quit flailing\naround. You're\npathetic.

entries.jp: そうそう\n夜中に戸を叩く音がしたら\n開けちゃいけないって
entries.en:
Oh yeah. If you
hear knocking
on the door in
the middle of
the night, you
mustn't open it.

entries.jp: この辺りの人達は\n本気で恐れてるっぽいよ
entries.en:
The people
around here seem
to be genuinely
scared of it.

entries.jp: そして……\nその時間がそろそろ……
entries.en: And... it's just\nabout that time...

entries.jp: はは……冗談だろ\nそんなもんが来た日にゃあ\n手も足も出ねえぞ？
entries.en:
Ha ha... You're
kidding, right?
If something like
that shows up,
we won't have a
leg to stand on!

entries.jp: 幽霊は手と足だけだけどね
entries.en: Well, legs are\nabout all she\ndoes have.

entries.jp: おいおい\n誰がうまいこと\n言えっつったんだよ
entries.en: Hey, hey! Who\nasked you to\nbe clever!?

entries.jp: ふふ
entries.en: Hehe.

entries.jp: ……なんだよ
entries.en: ...What?

entries.jp: 静かな夜だね
entries.en: Quiet night,\nisn't it?

entries.jp: へっぷしょいっ
entries.en: Ah-CHOO!

entries.jp: ぎゃあっ！
entries.en: GYAAAH!

entries.jp: ずるるっ\nどうかしたか\nシンディ？
entries.en: *Sniffle*\nSomethin'\nwrong, Shindy?

entries.jp: クシャミに驚いて\n目を回したみたいです
entries.en:
It seems the
sneeze startled
him so much
he fainted.

entries.jp: あーあ\nヘタレ過ぎて涙も出ないね
entries.en: Jeez. Such a\nwimp I can't\neven cry about it.

entries.jp: 総司　宴の松原の\n妖鬼は聞いたことがあるが\n女房の話は初耳だな
entries.en:
Soji, I've heard of
the demon of the
En no Matsubara,
but the court
ladies' story is
new to me.

entries.jp: 当然でしょ\n僕の作り話だし
entries.en: Of course. I\nmade it up.

entries.jp: あはは……
entries.en: Ahaha...

entries.jp: ふふ　良く出来た作り話だ\n目を回す奴が出るほどな
entries.en:
Heh. A well-made
story. Good
enough to make
someone faint.

entries.jp: 作り話か　よかった\n明るくなるまで\n眠れんところじゃった
entries.en:
Made up, huh?
What a relief. I
wouldn't have
slept till sunrise.

entries.jp: しかし　幽霊か……\n幽霊でも構わないから\n会いたいものだが……
entries.en:
Still, ghosts...
I'd like to see
him again, even
as a ghost...

entries.jp: いやじゃ　わしは\n幽霊は恐ろしいぜよ
entries.en: No way, not\nme. Ghosts\nare terrifyin'!

entries.jp: 俺は近藤さんの\n幽霊なら怖くはないな
entries.en:
If it were
Kondo-san's
ghost, I wouldn't
be afraid.

entries.jp: ……そうだね
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.jp: オッサンなら怖くないかも\nわしももう一度\nオッサンに会いたいぜよ
entries.en:
Maybe I wouldn't
be scared of ol'
Kondo either. I'd
sure like to see
the old man one
more time, too.

entries.jp: そうですね　あの人は\nいい人でしたから
entries.en: Indeed. He was\na good man.

entries.jp: たとえ　幽霊になっても\n怖がる必要はなさそうです
entries.en:
Even as a ghost,
there'd be no
need to be
afraid of him.

entries.jp: まあ　近藤さんは\n幽霊にはなりそうにない
entries.en:
Well, Kondo-san
doesn't seem
the type to
become a ghost.

entries.jp: 先に行って俺達を\n待っているだろうよ
entries.en:
He's probably
gone on ahead
and is waiting
for us.

entries.jp: 最期にそう言ってたしな\nなあ　総司
entries.en:
That's what
he said at the
end, after all.
Right, Soji?

entries.jp: ……うん
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.jp: そうじゃ！　わしは\n怖い話よりも思い出話が\n聞きたいっ
entries.en:
That's it! Instead
of scary stories, I
wanna hear some
old memories!

entries.jp: いいですね\n私も思い出話を\n聞いてみたいな
entries.en:
That's a nice
idea. I'd like
to hear some
memories too.

entries.jp: ふっ\nちょいと長くなるぞ
entries.en: Heh. This'll\ntake a while.

entries.jp:
夜の帳が降りて
静まりかえる中
しんみりと
近藤の思い出話が
はじまったのだった
entries.en:
As the curtain of
night fell and all
grew still, the
quiet reminiscing
about Kondo
began.
